koControl.expectedHealNote: counterfactual: expectedHeal is what the SAME hit would have healed if the holder had the item; with item 0 the branch is never entered, healDelta is 0 and shellBellDmg is left at 125 until SpecialStatusesClear on the next turn (frame 1623).

assertions: ARM (a) KO WITH SHELL BELL -- holder DUGTRIO 110 maxHP, chipped to 94 by the AI's TACKLE on turn 1 (frame 317, 16 damage). Turn 2 EARTHQUAKE KOs MAGNETON: gBattleMoveDamage 240 raw, gSpecialStatuses[1].shellBellDmg 125 (clamped to the HP actually taken), foe hp 0. MOVEEND_KINGSROCK_SHELLBELL (state 12) runs at frame 1398 ON THE KO: gBattleMoveDamage becomes -15 and shellBellDmg is cleared to 0 in that same frame (src/battle_util.c:3798/3801), moveendState halts at 13 while BattleScript_ItemHealHP_Ret runs. STRINGID_PKMNSITEMRESTOREDHPALITTLE (301) is emitted at frame 1433, and datahpupdate applies the heal at frame 1562: 94 -> 109, delta +15.

HEAL FORMULA HOLDS ON THE ROM: delta 15 == floor(shellBellDmg 125 / atkHoldEffectParam 8) == floor(125/8), the minimum-1 clamp (:3799-3800) not exercised; hp after 109 <= maxHP 110, so the datahpupdate clamp is not exercised either -- the measured delta is the raw formula.

SHELL BELL COSTS ZERO Random(): 0 draws land between state 11 (frame 1397) and the state-12 frame (1398) on either KO arm. The heal arm's whole RNG ledger is a byte-identical prefix of the control's (draws at frames 196/224/227/322/332/338/339/340/341/343/828/829/832), so removing the item shifts no draw -- the item's only footprint is the heal. King's Rock is not held, so :3776's draw never runs.

ARM (b) CONTROL (identical fixture, holder item 0) -- same chip (110 -> 94 at frame 317), same hit (shellBellDmg 125, foe hp 0), same state-11 frame 1397; at frame 1398 moveendState goes 11 -> 17 in ONE frame (states 12..16 are all no-ops), gBattleMoveDamage stays 240, holder hp stays 94 for the rest of the trace (delta 0), no string 301, and shellBellDmg is still 125 until SpecialStatusesClear zeroes it at frame 1623.

ARM (c) NON-KO WITH SHELL BELL (foe METAPOD, survives) -- holder chipped 110 -> 102, EARTHQUAKE deals 44 (foe 125 -> 81), state 12 at frame 1050 sets gBattleMoveDamage -5 and clears the record; heal lands at frame 1204: 102 -> 107, delta +5 == floor(44/8). Same shape as the KO arm, so the KO does not change the heal.

KO vs NON-KO: the ONLY gate a KO could have closed is :3789 (shellBellDmg != 0); PROGRESS 1402 already showed the record survives the faint, and this receipt shows the heal itself fires on the KO. :3792 (hp != maxHP) is the gate 1402 could not stage, and the two-turn fixture opens it.
Each arm was run twice from a fresh emulator and the two probe outputs are byte-identical (probeOutputSha256).
This is semantic RAM evidence; no framebuffer fitting and no runtime oracle dependency.
engineVerdict: NO ENGINE CHANGE. The kernel's MOVEEND_KINGSROCK_SHELLBELL Shell Bell branch (src/engine/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.ts) already computes heal = floor(shellBellDmg / 8) with the minimum-1 clamp, clears the record, and spends no RNG -- tests/issue129KingsRockKoReceipt.test.ts pinned that against source; tests/shellBellHealReceipt.test.ts now ties those kernel numbers to THIS live stock-ROM measurement.
